title: Consonant Digraphs
introduction: Recognise letter pairs that work together to make sounds.
definition: Recognise letter pairs that work together to make sounds.
rules: Practise sh, ch, th, ng and wh in familiar words.
Say the sound before blending the whole word.

examples.question: Complete: __ip (sh or ch), a large vessel.
steps: Ship begins with the sh sound.

examples.question: Complete: __air (ch or sh), something to sit on.
steps: Chair starts with the ch sound.

exercises.question: Complete: __ip (sh or ch), a large vessel.
exercises.solution: Ship begins with the sh sound.

exercises.question: Complete: __air (ch or sh), something to sit on.
exercises.solution: Chair starts with the ch sound.

exercises.question: Complete: __ree (th or ch), the number after two.
exercises.solution: Three begins with the th sound.

exercises.question: Complete: ri__ (ng or sh), jewellery.
exercises.solution: Ring ends with the ng sound.

exercises.question: Which starts like whale: wheel or chair?
exercises.solution: Whale and wheel share the wh spelling pattern.

exercises.question: Which ends like fish: dish or ring?
exercises.solution: Fish and dish end in the sh sound.

summary: Recognise letter pairs that work together to make sounds. Practise sh, ch, th, ng and wh in familiar words.
